content: कणिकः, -कणीकः .²1 A grain. .²2 A small particle. .²3 An ear of corn. .²4 A meal of parched wheat. .²5 An enemy. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a purificatory ceremony, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} waving round lamps at sacrificial rites. .²7 An enemy. .{@-का@} .²1 An atom, a small or minute particle; यथाऽश्वत्थकणीकायामन्तर्भूतो महाद्रुमः <ls>Mb. 12. 211. 2</ls>. .²2 A drop (of water); तामुत्थाप्य स्वजलकणिकाशीतलेनानिलेन <ls>Me. 98</ls>. .²3 A kind of corn or rice. .²4 Cumin seed. .²5 The अग्निमन्थ tree (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>नरवेल</ns>).
